name: Traceability
short_description: The ability to follow the recorded history of material and products through receipt, production and delivery, for example to support recall and containment decisions in manufacturing.

evidence.quote: iFAKT GmbH - Traceability and Genealogy - Tracking Every Part From Supplier to Customer
It records operations, operator actions, quality checks, traceability events, and execution states.
Some products need full traceability from raw material through production and inspection to shipment.
